entry.title: Otter AI can now follow conversations across 30+ languages
entry.summary: Otter AI just added support for 27 languages and revealed an upcoming feature that can follow along if speakers switch between languages.

entry.title: Cyberattacks threaten to make open source AI a little less open, Hugging Face exec warns
entry.summary: Hugging Face executive Irene Solaiman warns that growing cyberattacks on open AI platforms could force tighter security restrictions, threatening the accessibility that makes open source communities valuable to developers worldwide.

entry.title: Ring, known for its doorbell cameras, launches a home security drone and an enterprise security robot
entry.summary: Amazon-owned Ring is pushing into robotics with the launch of a home security drone and a rolling robot designed to patrol and protect businesses.

entry.title: Spotify’s AI DJ gets new voices, personalities, and an option for less chatter
entry.summary: Spotify Premium users can now customize their AI DJ with new voices with different personalities, or turn off the commentary between songs.

entry.title: After challenging Google’s Android with Cyanogen, its co-founder takes aim at Windows for AI era
entry.summary: Kora is set to launch as a free-to-use alternative to Windows, targeting users who rely heavily on AI models and agents.

entry.title: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share to reach an implied valuation of $1.404 trillion
entry.summary: The company could end up being worth a hefty $1.404 trillion if its shares list at the top of the price range, on a fully diluted basis.

entry.title: Adobe brings AI agents and new creative tools to Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly
entry.summary: Adobe is taking on Figma with a new prototype builder tool in Firefly.

entry.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse lands on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS
entry.summary: Users can now interact with Meta’s AI assistant through voice calls, text messages, or dictation on their Apple Watch.

entry.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
entry.summary: Google's new tensor processing units (TPUs) broaden its chip portfolio to more use cases: confidential model training and more memory capacity.

entry.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline
entry.summary: The affair could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.

entry.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
entry.summary: As participants talk, Claude can draft the plan being discussed, map out a timeline on a whiteboard, answer questions in the meeting chat, and access connected work apps to retrieve information, such as last year's figures.

entry.title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
entry.summary: OpenAI is looking to make ChatGPT a more robust consumer discovery engine, and a host of new features seek to empower businesses to help it do that.

entry.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
entry.summary: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a fundamental question about quantum computing that scientists have pursued for nearly two decades.

entry.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
entry.summary: The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”

entry.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
entry.summary: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company.

entry.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
entry.summary: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.

entry.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
entry.summary: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.

entry.title: Nvidia’s crisis has corporate governance experts reaching for the popcorn
entry.summary: The governance experts we talked to say nobody has seen anything like what's unfolding right now.

entry.title: Plurai wants to help AI agents work better using the same approach that helped get self-driving cars to roads
entry.summary: Like the end-to-end models trained to drive cars, AI agents are probabilistic systems operating in unpredictable environments.

entry.title: Databricks’ new AI agent tells CEO Ali Ghodsi the unvarnished truth
entry.summary: At 12,000 employees, AI Ghodsi is the first to admit that he can't know everyone and that they are unlikely to confess the things that go wrong to him. But he doesn't need them to. He uses Databricks' newly revised Genie agent for that.
